scripts.sync-sdk: (echo '// GENERATED COPY of experiments/cadencepay-sdk/src/index.ts — do not edit here.'; echo '// Update the SDK, then run `npm run sync-sdk` in this folder.'; cat ../cadencepay-sdk/src/index.ts) > lib/cadencepay-sdk.ts
scripts.check-sdk: node -e "const f=require('fs');const a=f.readFileSync('lib/cadencepay-sdk.ts','utf8').split('\n').slice(2).join('\n');const b=f.readFileSync('../cadencepay-sdk/src/index.ts','utf8');if(a!==b){console.error('lib/cadencepay-sdk.ts is out of date: npm run sync-sdk');process.exit(1)}console.log('SDK copy in sync')"
